resolvedFindings.problem: Query invalidation left old private canonical records cached when no detail hook was mounted.
resolvedFindings.fix: Discard targeted collection and cached-detail records on invalidation, preserving the mounted editor projection until its own authorized read settles. Retain only fresh committed records through mutation invalidation.
resolvedFindings.reproduction: Empty and failed replacement-query regressions both failed before the fix.

resolvedFindings.problem: Delayed mutation acknowledgements and metadata-only snapshot replacement could refill discarded private rows.
resolvedFindings.fix: Fence discarded IDs until a fresh authorized read. Fence omitted IDs before metadata replacement. Confirmed mutation receipts still clear recovery drafts.
regressions: Delayed successful engagement response after hard eviction leaves cache empty and clears retry draft.
Generic invalidation followed by delayed mutation cannot refill cache.
Metadata-only replacement followed by delayed mutation stays empty, then same-revision authorized read restores access.

resolvedFindings.problem: Creation relied on restoring receipt projections after metadata refresh; reauthorization could itself be superseded by a later invalidation.
resolvedFindings.fix: Read the created ID under live authorization after metadata refresh and guard its response with identity, read generation and hard-removal epoch. Never turn a confirmed creation into failure.
regressions: Authorized creation returns the final durable attachment projection.
Denied and invalidated-during-read creation remains confirmed once, without restoring cached private records.
